property_summary: For any caller and any address arg, calling SetLogFile(address) on a freshly deployed reference C (when not initialized) always succeeds and sets the public LogFile getter to that address; the mutant that permanently leaves locked_ = true can make a SetLogFile call revert (fail) when another nonReentrant_ call has earlier set locked_ to true, so there exist inputs (an order with a prior call that sets locked_) where the mutant fails while the reference still succeeds.
change_summary: Modify nonReentrant_ modifier to always set locked_ = true at end, preventing further calls and potentially causing SetLogFile to behave differently across call sequences.
